name: wander
description: Search, read, create and edit notes in Wander.

interface.longDescription:
Use your Wander notes in ChatGPT. Search and read notes, summarize what you've written, and save conversations as new notes. Edit a section, append text, add images from a URL or an uploaded file, and organize notes into folders.

View your note history, see what changed and who changed it, and restore earlier versions. Changes save directly to Wander as new versions you can undo. Publish notes to the web when you want to share them. Publishing and deletion require your approval.

Connect your Wander account and choose which vaults ChatGPT can access.
defaultPrompt: What did I write about pricing?
Save a short summary of this chat as a note.
What changed in my notes this week?

positive.description: Find and read the seeded pricing note
positive.prompt: What did I write about pricing?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds and reads reviewer/demo/Work/Pricing.md, quotes its actual points and names the Pricing note. Does not invent content.

positive.description: Save a chat summary in the demo Inbox
positive.prompt: Save a short summary of this chat in my demo vault's Inbox folder
positive.expected_behavior: Uses create_note to create a short Markdown summary in reviewer/demo/Inbox/ with a descriptive filename ending in .md, and gives the returned path.

positive.description: Edit only the to-do section of the seeded Lisbon note
positive.prompt: Add 'book flights' to the to-do section of my Lisbon trip note
positive.expected_behavior: Finds and reads reviewer/demo/Trips/Lisbon.md, then uses edit_note with the current version to add 'book flights' only to its to-do section. Preserves other sections; the edit lands directly as a new version.

positive.description: Store and embed a Lisbon photo
positive.prompt: Add this photo to my Lisbon note: https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/b/b5/Le_tram_28.jpg/1280px-Le_tram_28.jpg
positive.expected_behavior: Uses add_attachment with an HTTPS image URL or an uploaded file to store the photo in the demo vault's attachments/ folder. Reads the note first if its current version is not already known, then uses edit_note to embed the returned attachment path in reviewer/demo/Trips/Lisbon.md without changing unrelated text.

positive.description: Read the changes from the last week
positive.prompt: What changed in my notes this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Uses history with the start date of this week and lists the changed notes, who changed each one, and when. Reports an empty result honestly.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Lisbon tomorrow?
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call Wander tools; Wander does not provide weather forecasts.

negative.description: General writing does not need Wander
negative.prompt: Write me a haiku about autumn
negative.expected_behavior: Writes the haiku without calling Wander or saving a note unless asked.
Says that deleting a whole vault is not available through Wander tools. Does not delete individual notes or folders to simulate deleting the vault.

publication.release_notes: One tool for each job, with clearer names: search, read, create, edit and move notes, add images, list versions and restore one, publish a note to the web. Publishing, unpublishing and moving a note to the trash ask first on Wander’s side. Available in every country ChatGPT serves.
